title: Troubleshooting: uncollected payments
summary: This troubleshooting guide explains uncollected payments due within 16 days of creation. It covers what to do before vs. after the 16-day deadline (confirm 4-day reminder cadence, send manual reminders, verify contact details and split inclusion; after deadline, review split details, extend by recreating/reissuing, and clearly communicate next steps) and how to reduce future friction with concise split descriptions and early notices referencing reminders every 4 days.
faqs: When are payments due after the payment/split is created (what is the 16-day deadline)?
If the 16-day deadline hasn’t passed, how do I troubleshoot why a member’s payment is still uncollected?
How can I confirm that automatic reminders are aligned with the 4-day reminder schedule?
If the 16-day deadline has passed, what steps should I take to handle remaining outstanding members?
How do I extend an arrangement—should I recreate the split or reissue requests?
What should I include (description and early notice) to reduce friction and help participants recognize the charge and follow-up timing?
